checks: independent oracle, two normalized runs, rejected source mutation
cost: O(V+E) time and O(V) auxiliary space
description: Original deterministic bfs, global validation and bounded independent oracle.
forward: For valid G,s, d[v]=min number of directed edges in any s-to-v path; d[v]=None iff no such path. d[s]=0. First source error precedes first invalid edge in adjacency order.
inverse: In U=domain inputs crossed with all declared return values for one call, C=U minus R where R is the forward specification. This excludes every wrong successful vector/order, incorrect error and wrong first-failure precedence. Exact for the specification; partial source-derived absent-behavior approximant for Rust. Allocation failure, panic and elapsed time are outside U.

For every return y, Pre(y)={x in domain | R(x,y)} retains ALL compatible graphs and sources. Success fibers include arbitrary unreachable structure and alternatives consistent with the equations. Error fibers include every input satisfying the precise first-failure rule; no unique recovery is assumed. This is a relational specification, not an implemented inverse executor.
limitations: Bounded tests are not unrestricted proof.
Syntax projection excludes expansion and semantic resolution.
state: all finite directed adjacency lists with duplicates and self loops and a usize source; outputs are tagged errors or vectors of optional usize distances
